description: This source file contains unit tests for the 'repositories' package, focusing on database operations related to URL and branch ID management, caching behavior, and mapping of diff targets. It imports testing libraries and external dependencies, and defines multiple test functions for methods of the SourceRepository class.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes testing environment by clearing the ID table.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Resets the cache and clears the ID table after tests.

methods.name: clearIDTable
methods.description: Truncates the id_to_url_branch table in the database.

methods.name: TestProtocolStrippedURL
methods.description: Tests the function protocolStrippedURL to ensure it removes protocol prefix from URLs.

methods.name: TestGetOrCreateURLBranchID
methods.description: Verifies creation and retrieval of URL branch IDs from database and cache.

methods.name: TestGetOrCreateURLBranchIDCache
methods.description: Tests caching behavior when fetching or creating URL branch IDs.

methods.name: TestGetURLBranchByID
methods.description: Checks the retrieval of URL and branch by ID from the repository.

methods.name: TestGetURLBranchByIDCache
methods.description: Ensures cache hits return expected data even after database clear.

methods.name: TestGetDiffTargetToMapped
methods.description: Tests mapping of diff target projects to internal IDs.
